insufficient_bin_policy.limitation: Sparse >30° bin (A3): from pvlib geometry alone (no observations), only 19 of 222 calibration origin-days reach >30° (max 36.3°), against 122 of 123 evaluation days (max 45.0°). With the 20 origin-day minimum, every >30° cell has at most 19 origin-days, so it necessarily pools with the 15–30° cell of the same cloud class. High-sun evaluation hours therefore use a quantile estimated mostly from 15–30° calibration hours: a transfer risk, not a validated calibration. Required diagnostics (implemented M9): per-bin in-sample coverage and own-cell counts in the calibration artifact (calibrate_arm_c.quantile_table) and per-bin evaluation-window coverage after the run (gates_three_arm.arm_c_evaluation_coverage). Adequate high-sun calibration coverage is NOT claimed.

soc_parity_secondary.protocol_text_verbatim: SoC-parity-adjusted fuel = fuel + max(0, E_end,ctrl − E_end,arm)·(1/0.92)·f, with f ∈ {0.30, 0.75} L/kWh, the diesel's best/worst marginal efficiency from `diesel.yaml` (5 L/h base + 0.25 L/kWh at 100 kW and 10 kW)  [PROTOCOL.md §7, row 'SoC']
soc_parity_secondary.protocol_aggregation_semantics: NOT STATED. The protocol text has no origin index and no summation; it does not say whether fuel and E_end are per origin or totals.
soc_parity_secondary.aggregate_form_alternative: Σ_o fuel_arm,o + max(0, Σ_o E_end,ctrl,o − Σ_o E_end,arm,o)·(1/0.92)·f  (considered, not adopted; not implemented)
soc_parity_secondary.application_record: Delegated clarification of how the unchanged PROTOCOL §7 formula is applied (M9, 2026-10-11, before any evaluation run). Not part of the original preregistered text. Reasons: each origin is an independent 24 h episode that restarts at 50% SoC (make_initial_state), so an end-of-day energy deficit cannot be repaid by another origin's surplus; per-origin pairing matches the per-origin E1 deltas; per-origin penalty >= aggregate penalty, so it is the more cautious reading.
soc_parity_secondary.limitations: Secondary, reported only, never decision-bearing. Asymmetric: max(0, ·) gives no credit when an arm ends higher, so per-origin summation also penalizes day-to-day noise and is biased against arms. f brackets the diesel's marginal efficiency (0.30 and 0.75 L/kWh), both reported; no single adjusted value is chosen. The aggregate reading would give a smaller or equal penalty. Daily resets mean the adjustment does not represent multi-day operation.
soc_parity_secondary.f_source: diesel.yaml: 5 L/h base + 0.25 L/kWh -> 0.30 L/kWh at 100 kW, 0.75 L/kWh at 10 kW
soc_parity_secondary.E_end: e_after_wh after hour 23 of each origin
